title: 第13章 再遇诚意师兄第14章 任务
content_zh:
‘可惜我压根没练出火脉，你算是白死了。’
楚墨一边拾起柳衔的储物袋，一边暗自腹诽。有上品灵功《丹霞一炁洞玄经》在手，他怎么可能去修那《心火锻脉诀》。
清点战利品，《赤焰符法要略·卷一》与赤阳针无疑是最珍贵的两样。
尤其是赤阳针，位列上品，锋锐无匹，更能增幅火系术法威力，价值不菲。
楚墨在北崖集会见过类似品级的法器，标价动辄八百法钱往上，是他过去想都不敢想的天价。
柳衔不愧是活了一百多年的老登，家底就是丰厚。
除开核心宝物，那些杂七杂八的灵草、矿石加起来，也能换不少法钱。
“就当是你欠我的报酬。”楚墨嘟囔着将东西整理完，又双眼发光的打量着柳衔身体，“嘿嘿...”
尽管胸口有个大洞，制作成尸傀后威力会打折扣，但一个6级怪的底子，远胜之前3级的师姐。
迅速清理完战场残留，楚墨审视着【背包】中的收获，搓搓手指，心中已有规划：
“改日去把用不上的东西处理掉，换些解毒丹、生肌丹之类的必备物资...”
......
金乌与玉兔交映，便是数日光景的消逝。
楚墨将自己裹在一件毫不起眼的灰色斗篷里，脸上蒙着布巾，只露出一双警惕的眼睛。
虽然模样略显怪异，但这身装扮在此地并不突兀，北崖集会上藏头露尾者大有人在。
他悄然来到北崖集会一处相对僻静的角落，打算在这里摆个临时小摊，尽快将用不上的杂物脱手。
刚将几株灵草和几块品质一般的矿石摆出来，一个略带惊喜的声音就在耳边响起：
“哟！师弟是你！真是巧啊！洗心咒好用不？”
楚墨心头一凛，抬头便看到一张热情洋溢的笑脸凑了过来。那面容很是熟悉，让他下意识道：“诚意师兄？”
他对来人印象十分深刻，正是被自己白嫖了三门法术的罗山。

“你说什么？”罗山疑惑问，刚刚楚墨声音太小，他没听清。
楚墨轻咳一声，故意哑着嗓子说道：“师兄这是认错人了吧。”
罗山先是一愣，随即撇到他的装扮，恍然大悟，连忙道：“哦，对对，是我认错了。”
掩饰身份嘛，懂的都懂。
罗山很快被摊子上的东西吸引，目光来回扫视，啧啧两声：“师弟发了？可这些玩意儿.....品相一般呐，卖不上价。”
楚墨布巾下的脸有些黑，刚来就被认出来。他反手收起杂物，准备改天销赃。
“别走，别走。”罗山连忙拉住他，低声说道：“师兄我路子广，帮你打包处理了，价格保证公道！怎么样？”
楚墨沉默了一下，又取出几样从柳衔那里得来的、相对普通且不易追查的灵材，哑着嗓子道：“这些，什么价？”
罗山眼睛一亮，拿起一样样物品仔细查验，嘴里报出价格：
“冰凌草，保存尚可，四法钱；这块赤铜矿杂质多了点，三法钱......”
content_en:
'It's a pity that I didn't develop the fire pulse at all, so your death was in vain. ’
Chu Mo cursed secretly while picking up Liu Xian's storage bag. How could he practice the "Heart Fire Pulse Forging Technique" with the top-grade spiritual skill "Danxia Yiqidong Xuan Jing" in hand.
When counting the trophies, "Red Flame Talisman Essentials Volume 1" and the Chiyang Needle are undoubtedly the two most precious items.
In particular, the Red Sun Needle is of the highest quality and is extremely sharp. It can also increase the power of fire spells and is worth a lot of money.
Chu Mo had seen magical weapons of similar grade at the Beiya Gathering, and the prices were often upwards of 800 magic coins, which was a sky-high price that he had never dared to imagine in the past.
Liu Xian is indeed an old man who has lived for more than a hundred years and has a rich family background.
In addition to the core treasures, the miscellaneous spiritual herbs and ores can also be exchanged for a lot of magic money.
"Consider it the reward you owe me." Chu Mo muttered and finished packing the things, then looked at Liu Xian's body with shining eyes, "Hehe..."
Although there is a big hole in the chest, and the power will be reduced after being turned into a corpse puppet, the foundation of a level 6 monster is far better than the previous level 3 senior sister.
After quickly cleaning up the remains of the battlefield, Chu Mo looked at the harvest in the [backpack], rubbed his fingers, and had a plan in mind:
"Go get rid of the unused things another day and replace them with necessary supplies such as detoxifying pills and muscle-building pills..."
...
The golden crow and the jade rabbit complement each other, which means that the scene has disappeared in a few days.
Chu Mo wrapped himself in an inconspicuous gray cloak, with a cloth covering his face, revealing only a pair of vigilant eyes.
Although the appearance is slightly weird, this costume is not out of place here. There are many people who hide their heads and tails at the Beiya gathering.
He quietly came to a relatively secluded corner of Beiya Gathering, planning to set up a temporary stall here and get rid of unused sundries as soon as possible.
As soon as he laid out a few spiritual herbs and a few pieces of average-quality ore, a slightly surprising voice sounded in his ears:
"Hey! It's you, junior brother! What a coincidence! Is the heart-cleansing spell easy to use?"
Chu Mo's heart trembled, and when he looked up, he saw a warm and smiling face coming towards him. The face was very familiar, which made him subconsciously say: "Brother Chengyi?"
He was very impressed by the visitor. It was Luo Shan who had been raped by him for three spells for nothing.
"What did you say?" Luo Shan asked in confusion. Chu Mo's voice was too soft just now and he didn't hear clearly.
Chu Mo coughed lightly and said in a deliberately hoarse voice: "Senior brother, you must have admitted the wrong person."
Luo Shan was stunned for a moment, then put aside his clothes, suddenly realized, and said quickly: "Oh, yes, I admitted my mistake."
Everyone knows about concealing their identity.
Luo Shan was quickly attracted by the things on the stall. He glanced back and forth and said twice: "Junior brother, have you given it away? But these things... are of average quality and cannot be sold at a high price."
Chu Mo's face was a little dark under the cloth, and he was recognized as soon as he arrived. He put away the sundries with his backhand and prepared to sell the stolen goods another day.
"Don't go, don't go." Luo Shan quickly grabbed him and whispered: "Senior brother, I have a wide range of ways to help you pack it up. The price is guaranteed to be fair! How about it?"
Chu Mo was silent for a moment, then took out a few relatively common and difficult-to-trace spiritual materials obtained from Liu Xian, and said in a hoarse voice: "What's the price of these?"
Luo Shan's eyes lit up, he picked up each item and inspected it carefully, then quoted the price:
"Bingling grass, the preservation is still good, four dharma coins; this piece of cuprite has too many impurities, three dharma coins..."
